svg.title: Malaysia Transit Network — 30 cities and 11 synthetic lines
svg.desc: A map of the synthetic transit network generated from the GeoNames Malaysia extract. 30 Malaysian cities, including Kuching in Sarawak and Kota Kinabalu, Sandakan and Tawau in Sabah, are connected by 7 bus and 4 train lines. Long dashed segments cross the South China Sea.
svg.text: 30 cities · 11 synthetic lines · 7 bus / 4 train · seed 42

svg.text: Sabah and Sarawak are Malaysian states on Borneo.
Dashed links are synthetic sea crossings, not real rail.
Key cities labelled; Klang Valley and Johor clusters overlap; all 30 listed below.
Source: GeoNames MY.txt (CC BY 4.0) · 30 of 725 eligible cities · network: k=3, seed 42 · data/processed/cities_top30.csv + lines.csv
